about.lead: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
bioParagraphs: My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention.

Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research.

Beyond academics, I am an active advocate for animal welfare. I regularly participate in hands-on wildlife rescue operations with Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN), Bangladesh, and dedicate time to providing free clinical services for stray and campus animals.

I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in the veterinary, nanomedicine, and public health sectors to continue learning and contributing to innovative, evidence-based solutions in disease prevention under the One Health framework.

researchProjects.title: Comparative Immunogenicity, Protective Efficacy, and Safety of Nanoparticle-Based Rabies Vaccines in Mice: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
researchProjects.summary: Rabies remains a fatal zoonotic disease with a near 100% mortality rate once symptoms manifest. While traditional inactivated rabies vaccines (INVs) require multiple booster doses and strict cold-chain storage, next-generation nanoparticle-based delivery platforms (mRNA-LNPs, VLPs, lipopolyplexes, and nano-adjuvants) promise rapid, robust, single-dose immunity. Registered on the Open Science Framework (OSF), this systematic review and meta-analysis synthesizes preclinical in vivo murine data following PRISMA guidelines using a Random-Effects Model to evaluate Virus-Neutralizing Antibody (VNA) kinetics, post-challenge survival rates, and platform-specific safety profiles.
keyArtefacts: OSF Protocol DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/9AQS3
PRISMA Systematic Review Workflow & Risk of Bias Assessment
Random-Effects Meta-Analysis Model for VNA Kinetics (Days 5, 7, 14, 21, 28)
Murine Survival & Brain Clearance Synthesis across mRNA-LNPs & VLPs

researchProjects.title: Clinical Surveillance and Antimicrobial Stewardship in Companion Animals: Evaluating Veterinary Prescribing Patterns, Owner KAP, and Self-Medication Behaviors in Rajshahi, Bangladesh (A One Health Perspective)
researchProjects.summary: A 12-month prospective clinical surveillance across private veterinary clinics in Rajshahi investigating antimicrobial prescribing habits, clinical syndrome patterns, owner Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices (KAP), and hazardous home self-medication behaviors. Establishing the region's first structured One Health companion animal database to identify antimicrobial stewardship gaps and formulate evidence-based public health campaigns.
keyArtefacts: Curated database of 385+ companion animal clinical encounters
Prescribing pattern audit (critically important antimicrobials vs. empiric choices)
Epidemiological questionnaire on pet owner self-medication risks
Spatial syndromic surveillance across Rajshahi urban and peri-urban veterinary practices

researchProjects.title: Epidemiology and Distribution of Ectoparasites in Free-Roaming Dogs from the Semi-Arid Barind Tract, Northwestern Bangladesh
researchProjects.summary: A comprehensive year-long cross-sectional survey examining ectoparasitic infestation across 310 free-roaming dogs in the semi-arid Barind Tract. Collected 2,908 ectoparasites (1,245 fleas, 1,604 lice, 59 ticks) with an overall 87.7% prevalence. Established the first morphological records of Ctenocephalides orientis and Heterodoxus spiniger in Bangladesh, accompanied by molecular characterization (COX1 and 18S rRNA sequencing) of Haemaphysalis bispinosa and Dermacentor ticks showing key mutations at site 370.
keyArtefacts: First morphological records of Ctenocephalides orientis and Heterodoxus spiniger in Bangladesh
Molecular confirmation of Haemaphysalis bispinosa & Dermacentor spp. via COX1/18S rRNA
Negative binomial and logistic regression models identifying host body condition & seasonal risk factors
Spatial GIS mapping of ectoparasitic hotspots across the semi-arid Barind zone

researchProjects.title: Species Distribution and Risk Factors of Bedbug (Cimex spp.) Infestation in Student Residences at the University of Rajshahi
researchProjects.summary: Cross-sectional epidemiological investigation assessing the prevalence, morphological species distribution, and risk factors of Cimex spp. bedbug infestations across high-density student residences at the University of Rajshahi. Evaluates environmental sanitation variables, host bed characteristics across a 370-bed cohort, and psychological/sleep disturbance impacts to formulate university housing vector mitigation policies.
keyArtefacts: Comprehensive 370-bed epidemiological questionnaire & room-level micro-habitat assessment
Morphological classification of Cimex hemipterus and life stages (adults, nymphs, eggs)
Quantification of sleep disturbance indices and secondary dermatological manifestations
Baseline vector control recommendations for university residential halls

researchProjects.title: Socio-Veterinary Determinants of Pet Animal Healthcare Behavior: A Comprehensive Statistical Study of Pet Ownership Patterns in Bangladesh
researchProjects.summary: Multivariate epidemiological survey covering 361 pet-owning households across all seven administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Analyzed the profound impact of owner educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and regional accessibility on preventive healthcare practices (vaccination compliance, routine veterinary consultations) and uncovered structural barriers in veterinary healthcare delivery.
keyArtefacts: Accepted for publication in Journal of Advanced Veterinary and Animal Research (JAVAR)
Chi-square and Spearman correlation analyses across 361 household datasets
Empirical proof linking owner education directly to vaccination compliance (p < 0.001)
Policy roadmap for public-private veterinary infrastructure expansion in Bangladesh

researchProjects.title: Morphological and Molecular Detection of Capillaria spp. in Native Chicken and Duck of Northern Bangladesh
researchProjects.summary: Investigating the gastrointestinal parasite burden of Capillaria species in native scavenging chickens and ducks in rural Northern Bangladesh. Utilizing formalin-ether sedimentation, Baermann migration, ocular biometrics, and PCR molecular sequencing to characterize nematode diversity and assess economic impacts on backyard poultry producers.
keyArtefacts: Fecal sedimentation and intestinal scraping protocols for gastrointestinal nematodes
Biometric oculometer measurement database of Capillaria ova and adult worms
Parasite preservation and PCR amplification workflows under faculty supervision

researchProjects.title: Vector-Borne Pathogen Surveillance: Entomo-Virological Detection of Dengue, Chikungunya, and Japanese Encephalitis in Mosquitoes
researchProjects.summary: A 12-month longitudinal surveillance system in Rajshahi utilizing BG-Sentinel traps to monitor mosquito vector population dynamics (Aedes aegypti, Culex spp.) and detect viral co-circulation (Dengue, Chikungunya, and Japanese Encephalitis) via RT-PCR and ELISA pools, computing regional Minimum Infection Rates (MIR).
keyArtefacts: BG-Sentinel trapping grids across urban and peri-urban microhabitats
Entomo-virological pool screening protocols and Minimum Infection Rate (MIR) calculations
Correlation analysis between seasonal precipitation, ambient temperature, and vector surges

researchProjects.title: Livestock Drinking Water Quality, Trough Bacterial Biofilms, and Heavy Metal Bioaccumulation in Bangladesh
researchProjects.summary: Interdisciplinary evaluation examining bacterial biofilm formation in communal livestock water troughs, physicochemical water quality degradation, and heavy metal bioaccumulation (arsenic, lead, cadmium) in ruminant herds across Northern Bangladesh, evaluating nanoparticle-based bioremediation.
keyArtefacts: Trough surface biofilm bacterial culture and antimicrobial susceptibility assays
Water hardness, pH, microbial load, and toxic heavy metal profiling
Comparative assessment of nanotherapeutics for heavy metal chelation in livestock

softwareProjects.title: PoultryMedix
softwareProjects.tagline: Autonomous Multimodal AI for Avian Health & AMR Stewardship
softwareProjects.description: An autonomous AI triage and epidemiological surveillance platform tailored for smallholder and marginal poultry farmers in Bangladesh. Incorporates multi-modal AI diagnostics (synthesizing fecal image recognition, respiratory distress audio recordings, and regional vocal prompts), automated OCR optical scanning of handwritten prescriptions, and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge engine that issues mandatory drug withdrawal alerts to prevent antibiotic residues in human food chains. Integrates real-time GPS geolocation mapping to alert regional Upazila Livestock Offices (DLS) to infectious outbreaks.
softwareProjects.stats: AI Battle Winner / Finalist (Send a little Hope UK)

softwareProjects.title: ZunSync (Evidentara)
softwareProjects.tagline: Evidence in every line — Reproducible AI Research Platform
softwareProjects.description: An evidence-grounded, reproducible AI computational research workbench engineered specifically for veterinary epidemiologists, One Health scientists, and molecular researchers. Features end-to-end data provenance tracking, automated literature synthesis ingestion, statistical modeling pipelines, and containerized experiment reproducibility.

softwareProjects.tagline: Bridging Life Sciences and Modern Code
softwareProjects.description: A full-featured educational technology platform dedicated to empowering life science students with programming, computational biology, and data science skills. Manages interactive courses, student enrollments, programmatic certificate verification, and financial aid scholarship applications.
